quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ

parent_channels.name: Sky, Height, and Atmospheric Display

subchannels.name: Overhead Canopy and Layered Cloud
subchannels.scene_or_process: An elevated canopy covers the scene while cloud masses gather and mount in layers beneath it.
subchannels.active_motifs: elevated height `س م و:B001/m01`; high visible figure `س م و:B002/m01`; sky or overhead canopy `س م و:B004/m01`; layered rain cloud `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; one mass mounted upon another `ر ك ب:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: س م و at 82:1; ر ب ب at 82:6; ر ك ب at 82:8.
subchannels.synthesis: Height supplies the spatial frame, the canopy supplies enclosure, and cloud plus superposition supplies atmospheric structure. The surface sky therefore opens into a coherent meteorological scene rather than a bare location.

subchannels.name: Stars, Lunar Stations, and Calendar Beginnings
subchannels.scene_or_process: Celestial lights mark visible positions and recurrent divisions of the month.
subchannels.active_motifs: star in the sky `ك و ك ب:B001/m01`; white celestial patch `ك و ك ب:B003/m01`; lunar mansion called the Lion's nose `ن ث ر:B004/m01`; night of the balanced full moon `س و ي:B012/m01`; first appearance or beginning of a month `غ ر ر:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ك و ك ب and ن ث ر at 82:2; س و ي at 82:7; غ ر ر at 82:6.
subchannels.synthesis: The stars provide lights, the lunar mansion provides a fixed celestial station, and the balanced moon plus first-of-month sense provides calendrical sequence. Their scattering at 82:2 resonates with an ordered sky whose markers can also be displaced.

subchannels.name: Night Moisture, Southern Breeze, and Fertile Rain
subchannels.scene_or_process: Moisture arrives at night or on a mild southern wind and supports fertile land.
subchannels.active_motifs: nighttime droplets on grass `ك و ك ب:B004/m01`; mild moist south wind `ن ع م:B009/m01`; rain-bearing generous cloud `ك ر م:B002/m01`; sky as rain source `س م و:B004/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ك و ك ب at 82:2; ن ع م at 82:13; ك ر م at 82:6/11; س م و at 82:1.
subchannels.synthesis: Dew, soft wind, and rain form one atmospheric delivery process. The channel connects the elevated sky to the moisture by which terrestrial fertility becomes visible.

subchannels.name: Bright Prominence and Public Renown
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or place stands out as a bright, elevated, or widely noticed presence.
subchannels.active_motifs: good renown carried abroad `س م و:B008/m01`; brightness of a meadow `ك و ك ب:B006/m01`; conspicuous whiteness `غ ر ر:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: س م و at 82:1; ك و ك ب at 82:2; غ ر ر at 82:6.
subchannels.synthesis: Physical visibility and social visibility share the invariant of standing out from a field. A bright patch, luminous meadow, and good reputation all become forms of perceptible prominence.

subchannels.name: Terrestrial Figures Mirroring the Sky
subchannels.scene_or_process: Animal height, whiteness, or shape is described through comparison with celestial forms.
subchannels.active_motifs: bull likened to a star `ك و ك ب:B002/m01`; ostrich-like and lunar-station forms `ن ع م:B007/m01`; stallion rising over its herd `س م و:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ك و ك ب at 82:2; ن ع م at 82:13; س م و at 82:1.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene is analogical rather than astronomical: terrestrial bodies reproduce celestial height, silhouette, or brilliance. It preserves a recurring shape bridge between sky imagery and animal form.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Things become perceptible through elevation, overhead layering, celestial light, or weather-borne display.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the sky and stars anchor 82:1-2, while the same roots recur through latent senses at 82:6-8 and 82:13.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The sky scene extends into layered cloud, nocturnal moisture, calendrical visibility, public reputation, and animals used as celestial analogues.

parent_channels.name: Rupture, Dispersal, and Exposure

subchannels.name: Fissure and Forceful Opening
subchannels.scene_or_process: A surface splits and creates a broad opening through which what was contained can emerge.
subchannels.active_motifs: opening or splitting `ف ط ر:B001/m01`; broad fissure and issuing flow `ف ج ر:B001/m01`; slit or wide cut `ب ح ر:B003/m01`; visible cleft in an upper lip `ع ل م:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ف ط ر at 82:1; ف ج ر and ب ح ر at 82:3; ع ل م at 82:5/12.
subchannels.synthesis: Each motif supplies a distinct material instance of the same operation: an intact boundary becomes a passage. The bodily cleft and cut ear preserve the concrete morphology of the cosmic and hydrological rupture.

subchannels.name: Scattering, Tumult, and Group Dispersal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ordered contents are thrown apart, producing noise, confusion, and separation.
subchannels.active_motifs: strewing separate pieces `ن ث ر:B001/m01`; goods overturned and dispersed `ب ع ث ر:B002/m01`; agitation and mixed voices `ب ل ل:B009/m01`; people dispersing under every star `ك و ك ب:B008/m01`; a group departing in rout `ن ع م:B008/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ن ث ر and ك و ك ب at 82:2; ب ع ث ر at 82:4; ب ل ل at 82:9; ن ع م at 82:13.
subchannels.synthesis: Strewing is the core operation, while noise and routed movement describe its social aftermath. The stellar surface scene thus resonates with disturbed possessions, speech, and communities losing cohesion.

subchannels.name: Exhumation and Revealed Burial
subchannels.scene_or_process: Earth covering a body is turned back so the buried occupant becomes exposed.
subchannels.active_motifs: grave and burial `ق ب ر:B001/m01`; turning soil over a buried thing `ب ع ث ر:B001/m01`; placing or uncovering a body in burial `غ ي ب:B009/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ق ب ر and ب ع ث ر at 82:4; غ ي ب at 82:16.
subchannels.synthesis: The grave supplies the setting, burial supplies concealment, and turned soil supplies reversal. Together they form the explicit mortuary scene of 82:4 and its latent counter-movement from disappearance to exposure.

subchannels.name: Overturned Hollow and Collapsed Basin
subchannels.scene_or_process: A containing hollow loses its orientation or enclosure when its lower part is brought upward.
subchannels.active_motifs: basin demolished and inverted `ب ع ث ر:B003/m01`; enclosed or sunken cavity `ق ب ر:B002/m01`; low hollow where an object disappears `غ ي ب:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ب ع ث ر and ق ب ر at 82:4; غ ي ب at 82:16.
subchannels.synthesis: Hollow, containment, and inversion form one topological mechanism. It extends grave-opening imagery to any depression or basin whose concealed interior is exposed by overturning.

subchannels.name: Crease, Wear, and Concealed Material Damage
subchannels.scene_or_process: Folding leaves a trace, and repeated use turns that trace into wear or a hidden defect.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible crease left by a fold `غ ر ر:B001/m01`; folding while damp and carrying a flaw `ب ل ل:B007/m01`; cloth worn smooth, frayed, or threadbare `خ ل ق:B009/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: غ ر ر at 82:6; ب ل ل at 82:9; خ ل ق at 82:7.
subchannels.synthesis: The crease is the first material disturbance, damp folding preserves it, and wear is its durable outcome. The channel is a small-scale material analogue of larger rupture and exposure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A closed, ordered, or concealed arrangement is opened, scattered, overturned, or made visible.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 82:1-4 presents sky rupture, stellar dispersal, water release, and grave excavation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same mechanics reach folded material, worn cloth, confused crowds, migrating groups, and overturned basins.

parent_channels.name: Water, Moisture, and Sustenance

subchannels.name: Broad and Saline Waters
subchannels.scene_or_process: A large body of water spreads across an open expanse and may become strongly saline.
subchannels.active_motifs: abundant broad water `ب ح ر:B001/m01`; salinity or brine `ب ح ر:B004/m01`; deep gathered water `ع ل م:B005/m01`; abundant collected water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ب ح ر at 82:3; ع ل م at 82:5/12; ر ب ب at 82:6.
subchannels.synthesis: Breadth, depth, gathering, and salinity describe the physical state of a sea or deep well. They amplify the surface plural seas into a full hydrological body.

subchannels.name: Pools, Wells, and Water-Holding Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: Depressed ground or rock receives and retains water for later use.
subchannels.active_motifs: low ground that gathers water `ب ح ر:B006/m01`; rock hollow or new well retaining rain `خ ل ق:B011/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ب ح ر at 82:3; خ ل ق at 82:7.
subchannels.synthesis: Depression supplies the site and the rock hollow supplies the container. This is the contained counterpart to the released seas of 82:3.

subchannels.name: Water as the Mainstay of Travel and Life
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler or community secures enough water to maintain movement and continued life.
subchannels.active_motifs: water by which a party controls its affairs `م ل ك:B007/m01`; water that sustains the self `ن ف س:B008/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: م ل ك and ن ف س at 82:19.
subchannels.synthesis: Water is both substance and operational mainstay. Possessing it changes a journey from exposure to viable movement, making hydrology a form of practical sovereignty.

subchannels.name: Filling, Wetting, and Pouring
subchannels.scene_or_process: Liquid is driven into a vessel or surface until it becomes full or wet.
subchannels.active_motifs: filling a waterskin or feeding liquid inward `غ ر ر:B011/m01`; wetness and remaining moisture `ب ل ل:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: غ ر ر at 82:6; ب ل ل at 82:9.
subchannels.synthesis: The vessel supplies containment, filling supplies movement, and wetness supplies the resulting state. The process bridges water flow with storage.

subchannels.name: Thirst and the Measured Draught
subchannels.scene_or_process: A thirsty body takes water in discrete draughts yet may remain unsatisfied.
subchannels.active_motifs: severe thirst without satiation `ب ح ر:B014/m01`; a breath-sized draught or pause in drinking `ن ف س:B006/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ب ح ر at 82:3; ن ف س at 82:5/19.
subchannels.synthesis: The draught gives the unit of consumption and unrelieved thirst gives the failed outcome. The pair preserves water as a bodily need rather than only a landscape.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Water gathers, spreads, moistens, fills, or sustains life while its absence produces thirst.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the seas and their release anchor 82:3, with latent water senses distributed across 82:5-7, 82:13, and 82:19.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Water appears not only as sea and pool but as a travel resource, a measured draught, a filled vessel, and a determinant of settlement.

parent_channels.name: Creation, Form, and Development

subchannels.name: Origination and Effective Making
subchannels.scene_or_process: A maker brings an entity or action into occurrence from an initial act of origination.
subchannels.active_motifs: first origination `ف ط ر:B002/m01`; creating or bringing into existence `خ ل ق:B002/m01`; effective production of an act `ف ع ل:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ف ط ر at 82:1; خ ل ق at 82:7; ف ع ل at 82:12.
subchannels.synthesis: Origination supplies the beginning, creation supplies the maker-object relation, and effective action supplies realization. These motifs form the causal core behind the formed human of 82:7-8.

subchannels.name: Measure, Design, and Assembly
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parts are measured before action, joined, and fixed in their proper positions.
subchannels.active_motifs: prior measuring and estimation `خ ل ق:B001/m01`; joining one thing to another `ك ت ب:B001/m01`; fitted component in a composite `ر ك ب:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: خ ل ق at 82:7; ك ت ب at 82:11; ر ك ب at 82:8.
subchannels.synthesis: Measurement defines intended dimensions, joining produces structure, and fitting fixes each component. The sequence gives concrete mechanics to the surface statement that the human was composed.

subchannels.name: Proportion, Balance, and Visible Form
subchannels.scene_or_process: A created body is straightened, balanced, and made perceptible in a definite image.
subchannels.active_motifs: completed and visibly proportioned form `خ ل ق:B003/m01`; straight and complete constitution `س و ي:B002/m01`; bodily rectification `ع د ل:B005/m01`; perceptible created image `ص و ر:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: خ ل ق, س و ي, and ع د ل at 82:7; ص و ر at 82:8.
subchannels.synthesis: Completion, straightness, balance, and image are successive descriptions of one formed body. This is the most direct lexical expansion of 82:7-8.

subchannels.name: Willed Variation, Distortion, and Surface Quality
subchannels.scene_or_process: A form may be selected, made attractive or distorted, and given a smooth or irregular surface.
subchannels.active_motifs: creative volition `ش ي ء:B001/m01`; distorted or ugly configuration `ش ي ء:B002/m01`; smooth even surface `خ ل ق:B008/m01`; imperforate or blocked form `خ ل ق:B012/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ش ي ء at 82:8/19; خ ل ق at 82:7.
subchannels.synthesis: Volition selects the configuration, while distortion, smoothness, and blockage mark materially different outcomes of formation. Their contrast preserves variation without reducing every form to an idealized body.

subchannels.name: Nurture, Maturation, and Premature Emergence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A living or worked thing develops by stages but can emerge before its process is complete.
subchannels.active_motifs: gradual nurture and completion `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; attainment of mature strength `س و ي:B005/m01`; dough or material used before ripening `ف ط ر:B006/m01`; tooth breaking through `ف ط ر:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ر ب ب at 82:6; س و ي and خ ل ق at 82:7; ف ط ر at 82:1.
subchannels.synthesis: Nurture describes sustained development, maturity its expected end, and premature use or tooth eruption the moment of incomplete or forceful emergence. The scene extends creation into temporal development.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An entity is originated, measured, assembled, proportioned, and brought toward a mature form.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; creation, proportion, adjustment, image, will, and composition appear at 82:7-8.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The formation sequence extends into planning, fitted components, premature material, emerging teeth, smooth surfaces, and blocked forms.

parent_channels.name: Knowledge, Perception, Signs, and Records

subchannels.name: Knowing, Learning, and Sage Formation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A knower apprehends information, develops expertise, and can transmit it.
subchannels.active_motifs: disclosed knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`; practical knowing and informing `د ر ي:B001/m01`; cultivated learned person `ر ب ب:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ع ل م at 82:5/12; د ر ي at 82:17/18; ر ب ب at 82:6.
subchannels.synthesis: Apprehension supplies the cognitive event, practical knowledge supplies mastery, and cultivated learning supplies the formed knower. Together they expand the repeated epistemic challenge of the surah.

subchannels.name: Detection, Hearing, and Farsight
subchannels.scene_or_process: A perceiver detects an object through sight, sound, sensation, or long-range observation.
subchannels.active_motifs: seeing, hearing, or sensing a presence `ء ن س:B002/m01`; deliberate listening `ش ي ء:B005/m01`; long sight `ش ي ء:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ء ن س at 82:6; ش ي ء at 82:8/19.
subchannels.synthesis: Detection names the general perceptual act, listening its auditory mode, and farsight its extended visual mode. The channel preserves perception as a route into knowledge rather than conflating it with learned cognition.

subchannels.name: Memory, Vigilance, and Inner Comprehension
subchannels.scene_or_process: Information is retained inwardly while the subject remains alert against loss or error.
subchannels.active_motifs: retained content and faculty of memory `ح ف ظ:B002/m01`; vigilant self-guarding `ح ف ظ:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ح ف ظ at 82:10.
subchannels.synthesis: Memory preserves content and vigilance protects its use. This makes guarding at 82:10 resonate with cognitive custody as well as external surveillance.

subchannels.name: Marks, Banners, Landmarks, and Templates
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible sign distinguishes an object, guides a traveler, or provides a model for repeated work.
subchannels.active_motifs: distinguishing mark, banner, or landmark `ع ل م:B002/m01`; road sign or appointed marker `ء م ر:B005/m01`; model and single guiding course `غ ر ر:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ع ل م at 82:5/12; ء م ر at 82:19; غ ر ر at 82:6.
subchannels.synthesis: A mark identifies, a landmark or appointment orients, and a template governs repetition. The scene unifies semiotic and practical guidance through a visible differentiator.

subchannels.name: Guardianship, Writing, and Enrollment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Observed acts are guarded, written, and entered into a durable register.
subchannels.active_motifs: entrusted guardianship `ح ف ظ:B001/m01`; written text or document `ك ت ب:B002/m01`; entering a name in a register `ك ت ب:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ح ف ظ at 82:10; ك ت ب at 82:11.
subchannels.synthesis: Guardians supply continuous observation, writing fixes the information, and enrollment assigns it to a named subject or class. This gives institutional form to the record scene of 82:10-12.

subchannels.name: Unseen Content and Epistemic Doubt
subchannels.scene_or_process: Information is unavailable because it is concealed, absent, or held in doubt.
subchannels.active_motifs: hidden from sight or knowledge `غ ي ب:B001/m01`; unseen construed as doubt `غ ي ب:B006/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: غ ي ب at 82:16.
subchannels.synthesis: Hiddenness describes inaccessible evidence, while doubt describes the knower's resulting state. Their relation clarifies why absence can become an epistemic problem without making absence and uncertainty identical.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Information becomes available through perception, learning, memory, marking, or durable inscription.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; knowing appears at 82:5 and 82:12, guardians and writers at 82:10-11, and the limits of knowing at 82:17-18.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Knowledge is embodied in hearing, memory, road signs, templates, banners, registers, and the tension between hiddenness and doubt.

parent_channels.name: Judgment, Balance, and Deferred Exchange

subchannels.name: Judgment and Binding Determination
subchannels.scene_or_process: An authority evaluates conduct and fixes a binding outcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: reckoning, judgment, and recompense `د ي ن:B002/m01`; just adjudication `ع د ل:B001/m01`; binding written decree `ك ت ب:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Reckoning supplies the case, justice supplies the norm, and the written decree fixes the result. The channel captures the institutional mechanics implied by the repeated Day of Judgment.

subchannels.name: Equality, Parity, and a Fair Center
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two parties or quantities are brought into equivalent relation around an impartial middle.
subchannels.active_motifs: equivalence between two things `ع د ل:B002/m01`; parity and equal valuation `س و ي:B001/m01`; fair and known middle `س و ي:B006/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ع د ل and س و ي at 82:7.
subchannels.synthesis: Equivalence compares the parties, parity states their relation, and the fair middle supplies a neutral position. The surface bodily adjustment therefore resonates with mathematical and judicial balance.

subchannels.name: Ransom and Equivalent Substitute
subchannels.scene_or_process: One thing is accepted in place of another because it matches its value.
subchannels.active_motifs: ransom or equivalent substitute `ع د ل:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ع د ل at 82:7.
subchannels.synthesis: Substitution is a legal-economic relation in which a second item can stand against the first because it supplies an accepted equivalent.

subchannels.name: Deliberation Between Alternatives
subchannels.scene_or_process: A decision-maker considers competing courses before choosing one.
subchannels.active_motifs: weighing two alternatives `ع د ل:B008/m01`; consultation and managed opinion `ء م ر:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ع د ل at 82:7; ء م ر at 82:19.
subchannels.synthesis: Deliberation supplies comparison and consultation supplies social reasoning. The scene is the pre-judgment process by which an outcome is selected rather than imposed blindly.

subchannels.name: Debt, Credit, and Deferred Settlement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A transfer occurs now while payment, release, or completion remains due later.
subchannels.active_motifs: financial debt and credit `د ي ن:B003/m01`; sale or payment deferred to a later time `ء خ ر:B002/m01`; uncertain commercial outcome `غ ر ر:B009/m01`; emancipation contract paid by installments `ك ت ب:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: د ي ن at 82:9/15/17/18; ء خ ر at 82:5; غ ر ر at 82:6; ك ت ب at 82:11.
subchannels.synthesis: Debt establishes obligation, deferment separates exchange from settlement, risk clouds the outcome, and the installment contract turns payment into release. The scene is coherent commercial temporality rather than generic lateness.

subchannels.name: Delegated Credibility
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person's word or oath is accepted and a determination is entrusted to that credibility.
subchannels.active_motifs: authorizing a person's judgment or oath `د ي ن:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Delegation transfers decision authority by crediting a person's judgment, oath, or religious responsibility.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Claims, persons, or obligations are assessed through judgment, equivalence, counterweight, deliberation, or settlement.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; adjustment appears at 82:7, judgment and recompense at 82:9 and 82:15-19.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Judicial balance extends into ransom, balanced loads, credit risk, debt records, and delegated credibility.

parent_channels.name: Sovereignty, Possession, and Polity

subchannels.name: Lordship, Kingship, and Command
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sovereign possesses recognized authority over subjects and affairs.
subchannels.active_motifs: kingship and political sovereignty `م ل ك:B003/m01`; lordship, mastery, and ownership `ر ب ب:B001/m01`; office of rule `ء م ر:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: م ل ك and ء م ر at 82:19; ر ب ب at 82:6.
subchannels.synthesis: Lordship supplies the master-subject relation, kingship supplies public sovereignty, and office supplies institutional form. The convergence sharpens the transfer of all command to God in 82:19.

subchannels.name: Property, Disposal, and Subjugation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A possessor controls an object or person and can direct its use.
subchannels.active_motifs: ownership and power of disposal `م ل ك:B002/m01`; coercive possession and subjugation `د ي ن:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Property describes recognized control, while subjugation reveals its coercive extreme. Their contrast matters at 82:19, where no self controls anything for another.

subchannels.name: City, Administration, and Institutional Mainstay
subchannels.scene_or_process: A settled polity maintains obedience through an organized center and a sustaining principle.
subchannels.active_motifs: city where authority is obeyed `د ي ن:B006/m01`; mainstay on which an affair depends `م ل ك:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The city provides territory, obedience provides political relation, and the mainstay provides structural continuity. This is rule embodied in a functioning settlement.

subchannels.name: Vanguard, Animal Guide, and Shipmaster
subchannels.scene_or_process: A leading figure moves first and directs a following body.
subchannels.active_motifs: animal leader followed by the herd `م ل ك:B008/m01`; forepart and vanguard `ق د م:B007/m01`; chief of sailors `ر ب ب:B017/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: م ل ك at 82:19; ق د م at 82:5; ر ب ب at 82:6.
subchannels.synthesis: Vanguard gives spatial precedence, the herd leader gives follower structure, and the shipmaster gives skilled command. They are concrete analogues of authority as directional leadership.

subchannels.name: Command, Compliance, and Dependent Following
subchannels.scene_or_process: An order is issued and a subordinate either complies from judgment or follows because judgment is weak.
subchannels.active_motifs: binding command and request `ء م ر:B002/m01`; weak-minded follower seeking everyone's direction `ء م ر:B008/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ء م ر at 82:19.
subchannels.synthesis: The same root supplies both authoritative order and deficient dependence. The contrast distinguishes principled obedience from indiscriminate compliance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Affairs are ordered through command, ownership, rule, institutional settlement, and recognized leadership.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; lordship appears at 82:6 and exclusive command and non-possession at 82:19.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sovereignty reaches city organization, practical mainstays, animal leaders, maritime command, and the vulnerable follower who depends on others' decisions.

parent_channels.name: Worship, Observance, and Covenant

subchannels.name: Worship and Religious Obedience
subchannels.scene_or_process: A worshipper submits to a deity through an established religious practice.
subchannels.active_motifs: deity and act of worship `ء ل ه:B001/m01`; religious obedience and creed `د ي ن:B001/m01`; prescribed prayer `ص ل ي:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The deity supplies the object, religion the binding order, and prayer the repeated act. These roles form a complete devotional scene.

subchannels.name: Supplication, Blessing, and Sacred Invocation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker invokes God or asks blessing and mercy for another.
subchannels.active_motifs: prayer, blessing, and mercy `ص ل ي:B002/m01`; divine name in invocation `ء ل ه:B002/m01`; gracious prayer-response formula `ك ر م:B009/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ص ل ي at 82:15; ء ل ه at 82:19; ك ر م at 82:6/11.
subchannels.synthesis: Invocation names the addressed authority, supplication performs the request, and the gracious response completes the exchange. The channel joins sacred speech with beneficent social address.

subchannels.name: Repeated Observance and Ritual Place
subchannels.scene_or_process: Worship is maintained through regular observance in a designated place, with fasting marked by its permitted release.
subchannels.active_motifs: persistent observance `ح ف ظ:B003/m01`; worship place or shrine `ص ل ي:B008/m01`; ending or breaking a fast `ف ط ر:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ح ف ظ at 82:10; ص ل ي at 82:15; ف ط ر at 82:1.
subchannels.synthesis: Persistence supplies temporal discipline, the shrine supplies setting, and breaking the fast marks a ritual boundary. These are practical structures of sustained religious life.

subchannels.name: Covenant, Protected Honor, and Sacrilege
subchannels.scene_or_process: A binding pact protects persons and sacred limits until violation turns the relation into sacrilege.
subchannels.active_motifs: treaty and protected compact `ر ب ب:B011/m01`; safeguarding covenant and inviolable honor `ح ف ظ:B006/m01`; violation of sacred limits in the Days of Fijar `ف ج ر:B006/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ر ب ب at 82:6; ح ف ظ at 82:10; ف ج ر at 82:3/14.
subchannels.synthesis: Covenant establishes obligation, protection maintains it, and sacrilege names its rupture. The scene preserves fidelity and violation as opposite outcomes of one sacred social frame.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A subject binds conduct to a sacred authority through worship, prayer, repeated observance, or protected covenant.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; lordship at 82:6, denial of religion at 82:9, guarded and written acts at 82:10-12, and final divine command at 82:19.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The sacred frame includes houses of worship, breaking a fast, protective honor, treaty, and sacrilege.

parent_channels.name: Virtue, Benefaction, and Honor

subchannels.name: Truthful and Righteous Action
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person fulfills speech and action in accordance with goodness and obedience.
subchannels.active_motifs: truth carried through in word and deed `ب ر ر:B001/m01`; broad goodness and righteousness `ب ر ر:B002/m01`; beneficent or blameworthy quality of action `ف ع ل:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ب ر ر at 82:13; ف ع ل at 82:12.
subchannels.synthesis: Truth gives fidelity, righteousness gives moral orientation, and action makes character observable. The scene grounds the righteous of 82:13 in enacted conduct.

subchannels.name: Generosity as Abundant Increase
subchannels.scene_or_process: Benefit flows beyond sufficiency and enlarges the recipient's condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: generosity pouring forth widely `ف ج ر:B005/m01`; noble generosity `ك ر م:B001/m01`; increase beyond the initial act `ن ع م:B010/m01`; growth and blessing `ء م ر:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ف ج ر at 82:3/14; ك ر م at 82:6/11; ن ع م at 82:13; ء م ر at 82:19.
subchannels.synthesis: Flow supplies the image, nobility the agent quality, increase the operation, and blessing the outcome. The cluster makes generosity a productive process rather than a static trait.

subchannels.name: Welfare, Aid, and Favor
subchannels.scene_or_process: A need is met by benefit, support, or a favor that restores good condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: material benefit and social support `ب ل ل:B002/m01`; need, favor, or tightly held benefit `ر ب ب:B016/m01`; good condition and bestowed ease `ن ع م:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ب ل ل at 82:9; ر ب ب at 82:6; ن ع م at 82:13.
subchannels.synthesis: Need supplies the deficit, support supplies intervention, and ease supplies the resulting condition. This is benefaction viewed from the recipient's welfare.

subchannels.name: Honor, Prior Merit, and Elevated Standing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person receives standing because of noble quality or an established record of merit.
subchannels.active_motifs: honor and noble excellence `ك ر م:B001/m02`; prior merit or distinguished precedence `ق د م:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ك ر م at 82:6/11; ق د م at 82:5.
subchannels.synthesis: Noble quality supplies intrinsic worth and prior merit supplies an established history. Together they distinguish earned standing from mere display.

subchannels.name: Gift, Praise, and Courteous Response
subchannels.scene_or_process: A gift or commendation invites acknowledgment, reward, or a gracious verbal reply.
subchannels.active_motifs: gift offered in expectation of recompense `ك ر م:B008/m01`; courteous answer and willing acceptance `ك ر م:B009/m02`; explicit praise or commendation `ن ع م:B003/m01`; prayer for comfort of the eye `ن ع م:B013/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ك ر م at 82:6/11; ن ع م at 82:13.
subchannels.synthesis: Gift initiates exchange, praise evaluates it, courtesy answers it, and blessing extends goodwill to the recipient. The scene joins material and verbal forms of honor.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Good character becomes socially effective through truth, generosity, aid, praise, dignity, and gracious response.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the generous Lord and honorable writers appear at 82:6 and 82:11, while the righteous and blissful appear at 82:13.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Moral excellence extends into abundant flow, social welfare, prior merit, reputation, gift exchange, and verbal courtesy.

parent_channels.name: Falsehood, Deception, and Breach

subchannels.name: Fabrication and Imputed Falsehood
subchannels.scene_or_process: A statement or artifact is invented and then asserted or attributed as true.
subchannels.active_motifs: false statement or act `ك ذ ب:B001/m01`; imputing falsehood to a speaker `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`; invented speech or story `خ ل ق:B007/m01`; fabricated verse, report, or song `ف ع ل:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ك ذ ب at 82:9; خ ل ق at 82:7; ف ع ل at 82:12.
subchannels.synthesis: Invention produces the false content, assertion presents it, and imputation governs who is called false. The channel covers both making a lie and socially assigning it.

subchannels.name: Misleading Appearance
subchannels.scene_or_process: An attractive or patterned surface claims a condition it does not actually possess.
subchannels.active_motifs: lure through transient glitter or ornament `غ ر ر:B008/m01`; patterned cloth that lies by its appearance `ك ذ ب:B009/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: غ ر ر at 82:6; ك ذ ب at 82:9.
subchannels.synthesis: Glitter supplies attraction and the patterned cloth supplies a concrete deceptive object. Both make visual appeal the vehicle of false representation.

subchannels.name: Naivety, Bewilderment, and Hazard
subchannels.scene_or_process: An inexperienced or confused actor enters a situation whose outcome is uncertain.
subchannels.active_motifs: inexperience and easy credulity `غ ر ر:B007/m01`; hazard with unknown outcome `غ ر ر:B009/m02`; bewilderment or stupefaction `ب ح ر:B008/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: غ ر ر at 82:6; ب ح ر at 82:3.
subchannels.synthesis: Inexperience weakens judgment, bewilderment disturbs it, and hazard defines the uncertain environment. This is the cognitive mechanism by which a lure can succeed.

subchannels.name: Concealed Fault and Moral Breach
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person hides a defect or violates a protected standard while preserving an outward appearance of continuity.
subchannels.active_motifs: moral violation and torn restraint `ف ج ر:B004/m01`; folding over a retained defect `ب ل ل:B007/m02`; failure to preserve protected honor `ح ف ظ:B006/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ف ج ر at 82:3/14; ب ل ل at 82:9; ح ف ظ at 82:10.
subchannels.synthesis: The concealed fault supplies covert defect, violated restraint supplies the act, and lost protection supplies the social consequence. The scene joins material concealment to ethical breach.

subchannels.name: The False or Self-Deceiving Soul
subchannels.scene_or_process: Falsehood is attributed not only to a statement but to the inward self that generates or accepts it.
subchannels.active_motifs: soul characterized as false `ك ذ ب:B008/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ك ذ ب at 82:9.
subchannels.synthesis: The false soul internalizes deception as a character state rather than confining it to a single utterance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Appearance, speech, or conduct presents something other than the truth or fails a trusted relation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; delusion appears at 82:6, denial at 82:9, and the wicked at 82:14.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Deception includes fabricated language, misleading cloth and shine, naivety, hazardous exchange, concealed flaws, and a soul characterized by falsehood.

parent_channels.name: Time, Sequence, and Decisive Event

subchannels.name: Day, Duration, and Antiquity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bounded day sits within a longer span that may extend into remote antiquity.
subchannels.active_motifs: daylight period `ي و م:B001/m01`; unspecified duration or age `ي و م:B002/m01`; ancient time opposed to new occurrence `ق د م:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The day gives a bounded unit, duration broadens it, and antiquity extends it backward. Together they distinguish event time from long historical span.

subchannels.name: Dawn and Expanding Beginning
subchannels.scene_or_process: Light opens from darkness and the day begins to expand.
subchannels.active_motifs: dawn breaking from night `ف ج ر:B002/m01`; morning or day breathing open `ن ف س:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Dawn supplies visible emergence, while breathing supplies the shape of gradual expansion. The pair forms a coherent beginning process rather than a static timestamp.

subchannels.name: Before, After, and Deferred Completion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Acts occupy ordered positions, with some advanced and others left until later.
subchannels.active_motifs: moving or placing something ahead `ق د م:B004/m01`; temporal laterness `ء خ ر:B001/m01`; postponement to a later time `ء خ ر:B002/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ق د م and ء خ ر at 82:5.
subchannels.synthesis: Precedence fixes the earlier position, laterness supplies contrast, and postponement makes the relation intentional. This is the direct temporal architecture of 82:5.

subchannels.name: Crisis, Calamity, and the Decisive Day
subchannels.scene_or_process: A severe occurrence arrives, gathers force, and defines a particular day by its outcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: day as great event or ordeal `ي و م:B003/m01`; grave and astonishing affair `ء م ر:B006/m01`; sudden arrival of a multitude or calamity `ف ج ر:B003/m01`; acute crisis day `ب ح ر:B012/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The event supplies severity, sudden arrival supplies transition, and the crisis day supplies a bounded decisive interval. The repeated Day of Judgment resonates with other days named by what overtakes those within them.

subchannels.name: Habit, Continuity, and Residence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A condition persists because an actor repeats it or remains in place.
subchannels.active_motifs: customary state or habitual practice `د ي ن:B005/m01`; staying and enduring in a place `ر ب ب:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Habit provides repeated action and residence provides sustained presence. Their shared invariant is continuity across time.

subchannels.name: Prompt Action and Arrival
subchannels.scene_or_process: An actor acts without delay or reaches the destination after travel.
subchannels.active_motifs: not lingering before an act `ك ذ ب:B005/m01`; arrival or return from travel `ق د م:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ك ذ ب at 82:9; ق د م at 82:5.
subchannels.synthesis: Promptness measures the interval before action, while arrival closes the interval of travel. Both define completion by the absence of further delay.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Things are ordered by duration, beginning, precedence, delay, recurrence, or a singular event that changes the state of affairs.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; before and after appear at 82:5, the Day of Judgment at 82:15 and 82:17-19.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Temporal order includes dawn, ancient duration, delayed transactions, habitual practice, sudden multitudes, medical crisis, and arrival from travel.

parent_channels.name: Orientation, Travel, and Pursuit

subchannels.name: Direction, Inclination, and Intended Approach
subchannels.scene_or_process: A mover turns toward a chosen target or deviates from the proper line.
subchannels.active_motifs: intending and approaching a direction `س و ي:B004/m01`; directing oneself toward another `س و ي:B008/m01`; bodily or facial inclination `ص و ر:B001/m01`; deviation from a route `ع د ل:B006/m01`; deliberate aim toward a thing `ق د م:B010/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: س و ي and ع د ل at 82:7; ص و ر at 82:8; ق د م at 82:5.
subchannels.synthesis: Intention selects the goal, orientation aligns the mover, inclination changes bearing, and deviation marks failure to remain on line. The motifs form a full directional process.

subchannels.name: Clear Route, Middle, and Local Position
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler locates a traversable course by its clear trace and central position.
subchannels.active_motifs: clear unbroken road `ح ف ظ:B007/m01`; known middle or fair route `س و ي:B006/m02`; center or main line of road and valley `م ل ك:B006/m01`; named locality `ق د م:B009/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ح ف ظ at 82:10; س و ي at 82:7; م ل ك at 82:19; ق د م at 82:5.
subchannels.synthesis: The route supplies continuity, the middle supplies orientation within it, and the locality fixes position. This is navigation by stable spatial structure.

subchannels.name: Riding, Sea Travel, and Walking
subchannels.scene_or_process: Travelers move across land or water by mount, vessel, or foot.
subchannels.active_motifs: riding a mount or vessel `ر ك ب:B001/m01`; embarking by sea `ب ح ر:B009/m01`; travel on foot `ن ع م:B012/m01`; foot as the organ of tread `ق د م:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ر ك ب at 82:8; ب ح ر at 82:3; ن ع م at 82:13; ق د م at 82:5.
subchannels.synthesis: Mount and vessel provide transport, the foot provides unassisted movement, and sea travel supplies environment. The channel keeps distinct travel modes within one journey frame.

subchannels.name: Hunt, Ambush, and Targeted Pursuit
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hunters leave settlement, select prey, conceal themselves, and deploy a trap or shot.
subchannels.active_motifs: going out to hunt `س م و:B006/m01`; aiming at a person or place `د ر ي:B002/m01`; stalking under concealment `د ر ي:B003/m01`; hunting trap or snare `ص ل ي:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: س م و at 82:1; د ر ي at 82:17/18; ص ل ي at 82:15.
subchannels.synthesis: Departure begins the hunt, intention selects prey, concealment enables approach, and the trap completes capture. The sequence is a formed pursuit scene rather than a loose animal association.

subchannels.name: Chance Encounter, Capture, and Attachment
subchannels.scene_or_process: An unplanned meeting turns into seizure, attachment, or companionship.
subchannels.active_motifs: encountering someone without prior intent `ب ح ر:B010/m01`; taking hold and remaining attached `ب ل ل:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ب ح ر at 82:3; ب ل ل at 82:9.
subchannels.synthesis: Chance supplies the meeting and capture supplies its possible physical consequence. The scene traces a movement from accidental contact to attachment.

subchannels.name: Forepart, Hindpart, and Human-Facing Side
subchannels.scene_or_process: An object or body is oriented by front, rear, and the side turned toward its user.
subchannels.active_motifs: forepart or vanguard `ق د م:B007/m02`; rear or hind section `ء خ ر:B003/m01`; human-facing side of an object or mount `ء ن س:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ق د م and ء خ ر at 82:5; ء ن س at 82:6.
subchannels.synthesis: Front and rear define an axis, while the human-facing side situates a participant relative to it. The channel supplies concrete spatial anatomy to the surah's before-and-after language.

subchannels.name: Undertaking, Load, and Riding Pad
subchannels.scene_or_process: A rider assumes an undertaking and stabilizes the carried load on a mount.
subchannels.active_motifs: taking an affair or burden upon oneself `ر ك ب:B003/m01`; riding pad placed over a camel's back `س و ي:B010/m01`; counterbalanced load `ع د ل:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ر ك ب at 82:8; س و ي and ع د ل at 82:7.
subchannels.synthesis: The undertaking is the figurative burden, while pad and counterweight are its transport mechanics. The scene bridges responsibility and physically carried load.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A participant adopts a direction, follows a route, moves by foot or mount, or pursues a target.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; advancement at 82:5, composition and mounting imagery at 82:8, and control of movement at 82:19 provide anchors.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Orientation extends into body-sidedness, road centers, sea travel, hunting concealment, accidental encounter, capture, and balanced riding gear.

parent_channels.name: Competition, Precedence, and Courage

subchannels.name: Race, Second Place, and Interrupted Run
subchannels.scene_or_process: Competitors move in sequence, with a follower tracking the leader until motion falters.
subchannels.active_motifs: second runner following the winner `ص ل ي:B007/m01`; bold forward advance `ق د م:B006/m01`; wild animal running then stopping to look back `ك ذ ب:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ص ل ي at 82:15; ق د م at 82:5; ك ذ ب at 82:9.
subchannels.synthesis: Advance supplies effort, the second-place runner supplies rank, and the interrupted run supplies a failure of continuation. The scene distinguishes movement from competitive placement.

subchannels.name: Rivalry, Boasting, and Social Victory
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rivals publicly compare excellence and seek to surpass one another.
subchannels.active_motifs: mutual rivalry and boasting `س م و:B007/m01`; contest in generosity `ك ر م:B006/m01`; overcoming and precedence `ب ر ر:B008/m01`; severe contentiousness `ب ل ل:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: س م و at 82:1; ك ر م at 82:6/11; ب ر ر at 82:13; ب ل ل at 82:9.
subchannels.synthesis: Rivalry establishes comparison, boasting publicizes it, contentiousness intensifies it, and victory supplies the outcome. The channel covers social competition beyond literal racing.

subchannels.name: Precious Stakes and Competitive Desire
subchannels.scene_or_process: A valued object becomes the focus of desire, guarded status, and competition.
subchannels.active_motifs: precious object over which people compete `ن ف س:B010/m01`; elite or finest member of a group `غ ر ر:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ن ف س at 82:5/19; غ ر ر at 82:6.
subchannels.synthesis: Value creates desire and elite standing concentrates it. The scene shows why prestige and rivalry cluster around scarce or honored objects.

subchannels.name: Courageous Charge and Violent Contest
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fighter commits to an advance that may culminate in victory, wounding, or sacrilegious battle.
subchannels.active_motifs: battles associated with violated sanctity `ف ج ر:B006/m02`; combative contentiousness `ب ل ل:B005/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ب ل ل at 82:9; ف ج ر at 82:3/14.
subchannels.synthesis: Contentiousness supplies force and the named battles supply the conflict setting. Courage here is tested by participation in violent contest rather than claimed status.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Participants compare rank through racing, rivalry, boasting, daring, or decisive advance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; advancement at 82:5, moral rank at 82:13-14, and the follower relation latent in 82:15 support the channel.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Competition joins race order, social boasting, precious stakes, contentious character, battle advance, and an animal that runs then stops.

parent_channels.name: Craft, Materials, and Tools

subchannels.name: Leather Joining and Measured Tanning
subchannels.scene_or_process: Leather is treated in measured doses and stitched into a joined container or surface.
subchannels.active_motifs: leather or waterskin stitching `ك ت ب:B001/m02`; small measured tanning dose `ن ف س:B007/m01`; material worker or artisan `ف ع ل:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ك ت ب at 82:11; ن ف س at 82:5/19; ف ع ل at 82:12.
subchannels.synthesis: The dose conditions the hide, the artisan performs the work, and stitching turns separate edges into one object. The scene is a compact material-production sequence.

subchannels.name: Edge, Horn, Spearhead, and Adze
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hard implement receives a pointed or cutting end suited to combing, piercing, or carving.
subchannels.active_motifs: cutting edge of blade or sword `غ ر ر:B012/m01`; pointed comb-like implement `د ر ي:B004/m01`; adze used to carve wood `ق د م:B008/m01`; fitting a spear shaft with a point `ء م ر:B011/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: غ ر ر at 82:6; د ر ي at 82:17/18; ق د م at 82:5; ء م ر at 82:19.
subchannels.synthesis: Hard material supplies the component, sharpening supplies form, and fitting supplies assembly. The tool's function follows from the relation between shaft, point, and worked surface.

subchannels.name: Fitted Components and Structural Cohesion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separate parts are fixed into a stable whole whose strength comes from tight joining.
subchannels.active_motifs: fitted inset or blade component `ر ك ب:B004/m02`; material cohesion and firmness `م ل ك:B001/m01`; sparkle of worked iron `ك و ك ب:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ر ك ب at 82:8; م ل ك at 82:19; ك و ك ب at 82:2.
subchannels.synthesis: Fitting creates the joint, cohesion makes it load-bearing, and iron brilliance identifies a finished hard material. The channel is assembly viewed at the component level.

subchannels.name: Heating, Straightening, and Grinding
subchannels.scene_or_process: Heat or abrasion changes the shape and texture of a worked object.
subchannels.active_motifs: fire used to roast or straighten `ص ل ي:B004/m01`; broad grinding stone `ص ل ي:B009/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ص ل ي at 82:15.
subchannels.synthesis: Heat straightens and the stone crushes. These are distinct operations within one transformative craft field.

subchannels.name: Vessel, Lid, Bag, and Thick Paste
subchannels.scene_or_process: A container is made useful by enclosure, covering, and a substance that coats or seals it.
subchannels.active_motifs: carried sack or bag `غ ر ر:B013/m01`; lid set over a jar or pot `ك ر م:B005/m01`; thick syrup or paste used in treatment `ر ب ب:B006/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: غ ر ر and ر ب ب at 82:6; ك ر م at 82:6/11.
subchannels.synthesis: The bag supplies portable containment, the lid closes an opening, and the paste conditions or seals the material. The scene unifies container components and maintenance.

subchannels.name: Necklace and Anointment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body or object is adorned through a strung ornament or scented coating.
subchannels.active_motifs: necklace or strung collar `ك ر م:B003/m01`; scented anointment or colored perfume `خ ل ق:B010/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ك ر م at 82:6/11; خ ل ق at 82:7.
subchannels.synthesis: Stringing produces the ornament and anointment changes surface scent or color. Both are deliberate additions to appearance rather than changes to underlying form.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Raw material is measured, joined, sharpened, fired, ground, contained, decorated, or worked by a skilled hand.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; making at 82:7-8, writing at 82:11, action at 82:12, and fire at 82:15 provide lexical anchors.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The craft field includes stitched leather, spear assembly, iron sparkle, adzes, grinding stones, vessel lids, perfume, necklaces, and premature dough.

parent_channels.name: Body, Physiology, and Health

subchannels.name: Breath, Nostril, and Mouth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Air leaves the body through the mouth and nostrils.
subchannels.active_motifs: breath leaving the interior `ن ف س:B001/m01`; nostril and expelled contents `ن ث ر:B002/m01`; corners of the mouth `ص و ر:B010/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ن ف س at 82:5/19; ن ث ر at 82:2; ص و ر at 82:8.
subchannels.synthesis: Breath supplies airflow while nostril and mouth supply its bodily passages. The scene isolates respiration from the later discourse channel built on articulation.

subchannels.name: Eye, Pupil, Gaze, and Envy
subchannels.scene_or_process: The eye receives an image and directs a charged gaze toward another.
subchannels.active_motifs: reflected human figure in the pupil `ء ن س:B005/m01`; inflamed or protruding eye `ج ح م:B003/m01`; envious or harmful eye `ن ف س:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ء ن س at 82:6; ج ح م at 82:14; ن ف س at 82:5/19.
subchannels.synthesis: The pupil supplies optical reception, the protruding eye supplies visible intensity, and the harmful gaze supplies social effect. The scene spans anatomy, perception, and interpersonal force.

subchannels.name: Blood and Bodily Depth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Blood occupies bodily depth and functions as a visible life substance.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing blood as life substance `ن ف س:B004/m01`; depth and intense redness of blood `ب ح ر:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ن ف س at 82:5/19; ب ح ر at 82:3.
subchannels.synthesis: Depth locates the bodily interior and blood supplies its vital material. Intense redness makes the hidden life substance visibly legible when exposed.

subchannels.name: Knee, Pubis, Loins, and Hip Socket
subchannels.scene_or_process: Lower-body joints and reproductive regions support movement, posture, and generation.
subchannels.active_motifs: knee and its bone `ر ك ب:B005/m01`; pubic or genital region `ر ك ب:B006/m01`; loins around the tailbone `ص ل ي:B006/m01`; rounded head of the thigh in the hip socket `ك ر م:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ر ك ب and ص و ر at 82:8; ص ل ي at 82:15; ك ر م at 82:6/11.
subchannels.synthesis: Knee supplies locomotor articulation, the hip supplies a rotating joint, and pubis plus loins locate reproductive anatomy. The motifs form a coherent lower-body map.

subchannels.name: Childbirth, Lactation, and Milk Failure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Birth is followed by maternal recovery and milk provision, which may be scant or cease.
subchannels.active_motifs: childbirth and postpartum bleeding `ن ف س:B005/m01`; prolific childbearing `ن ث ر:B006/m01`; recently delivered milk ewe `ر ب ب:B009/m01`; fingertip milking `ف ط ر:B005/m01`; scant milk supply `غ ر ر:B010/m01`; milk that unexpectedly ceases `ك ذ ب:B006/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ن ف س at 82:5/19; ن ث ر at 82:2; ر ب ب and غ ر ر at 82:6; ف ط ر at 82:1; ك ذ ب at 82:9.
subchannels.synthesis: Birth establishes the maternal state, milking supplies the extraction action, and scantness or cessation supplies failure modes. The scene is a complete reproductive and provisioning process.

subchannels.name: Wasting Disease and Convalescence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Illness wastes the body before recovery restores strength.
subchannels.active_motifs: wasting disease with loss of flesh `ب ح ر:B011/m01`; back disease in sheep `ر ك ب:B010/m01`; recovery after sickness `ب ل ل:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ب ح ر at 82:3; ر ك ب at 82:8; ب ل ل at 82:9.
subchannels.synthesis: Wasting and back disease supply distinct pathological states, while convalescence supplies reversal. The channel preserves health as a transition rather than a static condition.

subchannels.name: Acute Crisis and Scorching Heat
subchannels.scene_or_process: An acute illness reaches a decisive turning point under severe heat.
subchannels.active_motifs: sudden medical crisis and crisis day `ب ح ر:B012/m02`; scorching July heat `ب ح ر:B012/m03`; severe bodily heat `ج ح م:B001/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ب ح ر at 82:3; ج ح م at 82:14.
subchannels.synthesis: Acute change supplies the medical event, the crisis day supplies temporal concentration, and scorching heat supplies environmental severity. The same heat that signifies punishment can therefore describe bodily danger.

subchannels.name: Abdomen, Scalp, and Birth Caul
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bodily surfaces and coverings are marked by enlargement, irritation, or a membrane around birth.
subchannels.active_motifs: enlarged abdomen `ب ح ر:B013/m01`; scalp itch and desire for scratching `ص و ر:B008/m01`; caul or omental fat `غ ي ب:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ب ح ر at 82:3; ص و ر at 82:8; غ ي ب at 82:16.
subchannels.synthesis: The abdomen supplies bulk, the scalp supplies irritated surface, and the caul supplies a bodily covering. These concrete anatomical states resist absorption into a generic body label.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Life is maintained and perceived through breath, blood, sensory organs, reproduction, nourishment, and bodily integrity.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the human body is formed at 82:6-8, the self appears at 82:5 and 82:19, and burning at 82:14-15 supplies health and injury contrasts.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The body ledger reaches nostrils, pupils, blood depth, pelvic anatomy, lactation, wasting disease, crisis heat, paunch, scalp itch, and the birth caul.

parent_channels.name: Fire, Anger, and Violent Conflict

subchannels.name: Flame and Endured Heat
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fire blazes intensely and a body enters or endures its heat.
subchannels.active_motifs: blazing fire and concentrated heat `ج ح م:B001/m01`; entering or suffering fire `ص ل ي:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ج ح م at 82:14; ص ل ي at 82:15.
subchannels.synthesis: Blaze supplies the setting and entering it supplies the affected participant. This is the direct punitive fire scene of 82:14-15.

subchannels.name: Anger, Facial Heat, and Guarded Pride
subchannels.scene_or_process: Inner anger rises as heat, becomes visible in the face, and mobilizes defensive pride.
subchannels.active_motifs: face inflamed by anger `ج ح م:B004/m01`; protective anger and pride `ح ف ظ:B005/m01`; nose-tip posture of an angry person `ق ب ر:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ج ح م at 82:14; ح ف ظ at 82:10; ق ب ر at 82:4.
subchannels.synthesis: Heat supplies the bodily metaphor, facial posture supplies visible expression, and protective pride supplies motive. Anger is rendered as a fire moving from interior state to social display.

subchannels.name: Battle, Armor, and Wounding
subchannels.scene_or_process: Armed combat reaches a heated clash in which armor protects bodies from penetrating blows.
subchannels.active_motifs: battle at its fiercest and deadliest `ج ح م:B002/m01`; full-body coat of mail `ن ث ر:B005/m01`; blood-drawing combat thrust `ن ث ر:B003/m01`; committed or failed charge `ك ذ ب:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ج ح م at 82:14; ن ث ر at 82:2; ك ذ ب at 82:9.
subchannels.synthesis: Battle supplies the setting, armor the defense, thrust the injury mechanism, and charge the fighter's commitment. The channel is a complete violent-conflict scene.

subchannels.name: Brazenness and Violated Restraint
subchannels.scene_or_process: Shame and moral restraint are cast off, producing exposed and aggressive conduct.
subchannels.active_motifs: deficient modesty or shamelessness `ج ح م:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ج ح م at 82:14.
subchannels.synthesis: The motif forms a coherent character state in which restraint and shame are absent, intensifying the fire root's reach from heat into exposed conduct.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Heat intensifies from physical flame into anger, battle, injury, and moral brazenness.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the wicked are in blazing fire at 82:14 and enter it at 82:15.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Fire becomes a face flushed by rage, guarded pride, battlefield heat, armor, nose-first trauma, and shameless exposure.

parent_channels.name: Plant Life, Food, and Agriculture

subchannels.name: Grain, Berry, and Vine
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cultivated or gathered plants yield edible grain and fruit.
subchannels.active_motifs: wheat and grain food `ب ر ر:B006/m01`; arak berry `ب ر ر:B007/m01`; grapevine and grapes `ك ر م:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ب ر ر at 82:13; ك ر م at 82:6/11.
subchannels.synthesis: Grain supplies staple food, berry supplies gathered fruit, and vine supplies cultivated fruit. The scene is a compact edible-plant inventory.

subchannels.name: Palm Offshoot and Seedling
subchannels.scene_or_process: A young plant emerges from a parent trunk or grows as a small palm.
subchannels.active_motifs: young palms `ش ي ء:B006/m01`; parallel young-palm branch sense `ش ي ء:B008/m01`; palm offshoot growing above the ground `ر ك ب:B007/m01`; cluster or grove of palms `ص و ر:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ش ي ء and ر ك ب and ص و ر at 82:8/19 and 82:8.
subchannels.synthesis: The young palm supplies the organism, the offshoot supplies propagation, and the grove supplies mature grouping. The duplicate palm evidence is consolidated into one botanical process while preserving both branch containers.

subchannels.name: Mushroom Emergence and Foraging
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fungus appears rapidly from the ground and is gathered as food.
subchannels.active_motifs: mushroom or truffle-like growth `ف ط ر:B008/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ف ط ر at 82:1.
subchannels.synthesis: The motif forms a complete singleton scene of sudden edible emergence. Its shape and rapid appearance resonate with opening and origination without being reduced to either.

subchannels.name: Pasture, Rain-Fed Growth, and Animal Fodder
subchannels.scene_or_process: Moist soil supports persistent vegetation that becomes pasture.
subchannels.active_motifs: evergreen herb or plant `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; grass eaten by camels `ص ل ي:B010/m01`; fertile soil and productive vegetation `ك ر م:B002/m02`; watered meadow in low ground `ب ح ر:B006/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ر ب ب at 82:6; ص ل ي at 82:15; ك ر م at 82:6/11; ب ح ر at 82:3.
subchannels.synthesis: Watered ground supplies setting, persistent vegetation supplies growth, and fodder supplies ecological function. The scene links atmospheric benefit to animal subsistence.

subchannels.name: Hidden Root and Planted Row
subchannels.scene_or_process: Roots remain concealed below ground while plants are arranged in visible rows above it.
subchannels.active_motifs: buried roots later exposed by digging `غ ي ب:B008/m01`; planted row or raised strip of cultivation `ر ك ب:B009/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: غ ي ب at 82:16; ر ك ب at 82:8.
subchannels.synthesis: Hidden roots supply the below-ground support and the planted row supplies ordered surface growth. The contrast forms a vertical agricultural structure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Plants emerge, propagate, feed animals or humans, and depend on soil and water.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; water at 82:3, lordly nurture at 82:6, and ease at 82:13 provide the principal anchors.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel includes wheat, arak berries, palms, mushrooms, pasture grass, hidden roots, vine fruit, and planted rows.

parent_channels.name: Animal Life, Herds, and Birds

subchannels.name: Herds, Cattle, and Livestock Wealth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Domestic or wild animals move as a collective herd and function as subsistence wealth.
subchannels.active_motifs: herd of wild cattle or camels `ر ب ب:B014/m01`; cattle herd `ص و ر:B006/m01`; livestock wealth, especially camels `ن ع م:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ر ب ب at 82:6; ص و ر at 82:8; ن ع م at 82:13.
subchannels.synthesis: Herd supplies collective movement, cattle supplies species form, and livestock supplies economic role. The channel separates animal aggregation from the authority of the leading animal.

subchannels.name: Ewe, Lamb, and Recent Birth
subchannels.scene_or_process: A newly delivered ewe remains near shelter with her young lamb.
subchannels.active_motifs: young lamb `ء م ر:B009/m01`; ewe recently delivered and retained for milk `ر ب ب:B009/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ء م ر at 82:19; ر ب ب at 82:6.
subchannels.synthesis: The lamb supplies offspring and the recently delivered ewe supplies maternal role and setting. This is the animal counterpart to the human birth-and-lactation scene.

subchannels.name: Lark, Raptor, Ostrich, and Calling Bird
subchannels.scene_or_process: Distinct birds are recognized by species, flight, predation, or characteristic call.
subchannels.active_motifs: lark `ق ب ر:B003/m01`; falcon or hawk `ع ل م:B006/m01`; ostrich `ن ع م:B006/m01`; nightingale or calling bird `ب ل ل:B010/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ق ب ر at 82:4; ع ل م at 82:5/12; ن ع م at 82:13; ب ل ل at 82:9.
subchannels.synthesis: Species names provide the inventory, predation distinguishes the raptor, and vocalization distinguishes the calling bird. The channel preserves concrete ornithology rather than treating all birds as decorative imagery.

subchannels.name: Hyena and Other Wild Species
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wild animals are identified by sex, species, and relation to open or concealed habitat.
subchannels.active_motifs: male hyena `ع ل م:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The branch forms a coherent species-level singleton within the animal parent, keeping a named wild predator visible alongside domesticated herds and birds.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Animals gather by species and role as herd, domestic stock, bird, predator, or named young.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; stars at 82:2, the human at 82:6, and ease at 82:13 activate numerous animal analogies and lexical species.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The inventory reaches wild cattle, livestock wealth, a lamb, lark, raptor, nightingale, ostrich, hyena, and animal leadership.

parent_channels.name: Speech, Naming, and Discourse

subchannels.name: Articulation, Voice, and Noise
subchannels.scene_or_process: Breath is shaped by tongue placement into speech, call, or noisy vocalization.
subchannels.active_motifs: tongue placed at articulation points `ب ل ل:B006/m01`; noisy or repeated speech `ب ر ر:B004/m01`; moan, water-sound, or bird call `ب ل ل:B010/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ب ل ل at 82:9; ب ر ر at 82:13.
subchannels.synthesis: Tongue placement supplies the mechanism, voice supplies the output, and noise or call supplies variation in communicative form. The channel links bodily phonetics to audible discourse.

subchannels.name: Grammar and Syntactic Roles
subchannels.scene_or_process: Grammatical relations organize participants and modify scope or quantity.
subchannels.active_motifs: grammatical objects and complements `ف ع ل:B007/m01`; particle of approximation or quantification `ر ب ب:B015/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ف ع ل at 82:12; ر ب ب at 82:6.
subchannels.synthesis: Grammatical objects assign semantic roles, while the particle modifies relation or quantity. The scene is language treated as structured representation.

subchannels.name: Assent and Corrective Redirection
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker first confirms or then redirects the proposition under discussion.
subchannels.active_motifs: affirmative yes `ن ع م:B004/m01`; corrective particle bal `ب ل ل:B008/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ن ع م at 82:13; ب ل ل at 82:9.
subchannels.synthesis: Assent preserves the prior proposition, while correction interrupts and replaces its direction. Their contrast forms a compact dialogue mechanism.

subchannels.name: Lament and Emotional Exclamation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Shock or grief interrupts ordinary discourse with an exclamation.
subchannels.active_motifs: lamenting exclamation `ش ي ء:B007/m01`; parallel exclamation of grief or amazement `ش ي ء:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Both branch containers preserve the same discourse event and are grouped under one motif class: affect forces itself into speech as an interruption.

subchannels.name: Naming and Invocation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A referent is assigned a name and may then be called upon through that designation.
subchannels.active_motifs: naming, name, and namesake `س م و:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: س م و at 82:1.
subchannels.synthesis: Naming establishes a sign-referent relation and makes a person or thing available for classification and direct address.

subchannels.name: Exhortation and Binding Speech
subchannels.scene_or_process: A formula urges a hearer toward an action and presents it as obligatory.
subchannels.active_motifs: formula meaning hold to or undertake an act `ك ذ ب:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ك ذ ب at 82:9.
subchannels.synthesis: The exhortative formula shows speech acting directly upon conduct by presenting an undertaking as immediately incumbent.

subchannels.name: Reciprocal Action
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two participants perform an action in relation to one another.
subchannels.active_motifs: action occurring between two parties `ف ع ل:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ف ع ل at 82:12.
subchannels.synthesis: The branch forms a standalone discourse-relation scene within the language parent: the grammatical form encodes mutual participation rather than a one-directional act.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Meaning is produced and managed through articulation, writing, naming, response, correction, lament, and directive speech.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; denial at 82:9, writing at 82:11, knowing acts at 82:12, and repeated questioning at 82:17-18 establish the discourse frame.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Speech reaches tongue placement, animal-like calls, grammatical objects, reciprocal action, interjections, naming, and exhortation.

parent_channels.name: Self, Character, and Social Relation

subchannels.name: Living Self and Personal Identity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A living human acts and remains the same identifiable subject across judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: life-bearing soul `ن ف س:B011/m01`; identity or very self of a thing `ن ف س:B012/m01`; individual human being `ء ن س:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ن ف س at 82:5/19; ء ن س at 82:6.
subchannels.synthesis: Life supplies animation, identity supplies persistence, and the human supplies embodied subjecthood. This is the agent who knows deeds at 82:5 and lacks power at 82:19.

subchannels.name: Mind, Intention, and Disposition
subchannels.scene_or_process: Inward cognition directs action while durable character shapes how the person responds.
subchannels.active_motifs: intention, intellect, and inward thought `ن ف س:B013/m01`; courage, pride, generosity, or temperament `ن ف س:B014/m01`; ingrained disposition `خ ل ق:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ن ف س at 82:5/19; خ ل ق at 82:7.
subchannels.synthesis: Intention supplies immediate direction, intellect supplies reflection, and disposition supplies durable tendency. The channel distinguishes momentary thought from formed character.

subchannels.name: Intimacy, Favorite, and Admiration
subchannels.scene_or_process: Familiarity develops into close companionship, trusted confidence, or delighted attachment.
subchannels.active_motifs: intimate companionship `ء ن س:B003/m01`; confidant or chosen companion `ء ن س:B006/m01`; admiration and delight in another `ش ي ء:B004/m01`; dearly valued person `ك ر م:B010/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ء ن س and ك ر م at 82:6/11; ش ي ء at 82:8/19.
subchannels.synthesis: Familiarity removes distance, confidence establishes trust, admiration supplies affect, and dearness stabilizes attachment. The scene is a graded movement toward intimacy.

subchannels.name: Backbiting and Protection of the Absent
subchannels.scene_or_process: An absent person's reputation becomes vulnerable to hostile mention or active defense.
subchannels.active_motifs: speaking of a person in absence `غ ي ب:B004/m01`; defending another's absent honor `ح ف ظ:B006/m03`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: غ ي ب at 82:16; ح ف ظ at 82:10.
subchannels.synthesis: Absence creates the vulnerable setting, mention supplies the harmful act, and protection supplies its ethical opposite. The channel turns hiddenness into a social-reputation relation.

subchannels.name: Humanity and Multitude
subchannels.scene_or_process: Individual humans gather into a large social body.
subchannels.active_motifs: humankind as a collective `ء ن س:B001/m02`; large assembled groups or thousands `ر ب ب:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ء ن س and ر ب ب at 82:6.
subchannels.synthesis: The human category supplies membership and the multitude supplies scale. This scene expands the singular addressee of 82:6 into society.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A person persists as a living self with identity, inward disposition, intimate bonds, and a position within a community.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the self appears at 82:5 and twice at 82:19, while the human is addressed at 82:6.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Selfhood extends into intellect, courage, confidants, favorite persons, backbiting, hidden reputation, and large human collectives.

parent_channels.name: Household, Kinship, and Lineage

subchannels.name: Marriage, Stepchild, and Caregiver
subchannels.scene_or_process: Marriage forms a household in which an adult assumes care for a child from an earlier union.
subchannels.active_motifs: marriage contract `م ل ك:B004/m01`; stepchild and responsible caregiver `ر ب ب:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: م ل ك at 82:19; ر ب ب at 82:6.
subchannels.synthesis: Marriage establishes the household relation, the stepchild supplies the dependent participant, and the caregiver supplies the nurturing role. The scene is complete without importing unrelated ownership senses.

subchannels.name: Kin Care and Connection
subchannels.scene_or_process: Relatives maintain connection through kindness, benefit, and protection against estrangement.
subchannels.active_motifs: kindness toward parents, children, and kin `ب ر ر:B003/m01`; benefit figured as moistening kinship `ب ل ل:B002/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ب ر ر at 82:13; ب ل ل at 82:9.
subchannels.synthesis: Kinship establishes obligation, kindness supplies action, and benefit supplies material effect. The moistening image presents care as what keeps a relation from drying out or breaking.

subchannels.name: Lineage and Beloved Stock
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person is valued through origin, descent, or membership in an honored line.
subchannels.active_motifs: origin, lineage, or noble stock `ر ك ب:B008/m01`; beloved or precious member of one's people `ك ر م:B010/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ر ك ب at 82:8; ك ر م at 82:6/11.
subchannels.synthesis: Lineage supplies inherited placement and beloved status supplies affective valuation. The channel separates family standing from competitive prestige.

subchannels.name: Reproductive Closure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bodily blockage prevents ordinary reproductive passage and threatens household continuity.
subchannels.active_motifs: imperforate reproductive condition `خ ل ق:B012/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: خ ل ق at 82:7.
subchannels.synthesis: The motif forms a coherent singleton social consequence within the household parent: a concrete bodily closure becomes a barrier to reproduction.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Persons are joined through marriage, descent, care, and obligations toward relatives.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; lordly nurture at 82:6, formed bodies at 82:7-8, beneficence at 82:13, and possession at 82:19 provide anchors.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Household relation includes stepchildren, caregivers, marriage contracts, lineage, favored kin, and care opposed to estrangement.

parent_channels.name: Place, Settlement, and Habitation

subchannels.name: City and Agreeable Residence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A population settles in a city whose order and environment make residence possible.
subchannels.active_motifs: city as settled place of obedience `د ي ن:B006/m02`; land that agrees with its inhabitant `ن ع م:B011/m01`; staying permanently in a place `ر ب ب:B007/m02`.
subchannels.synthesis: City supplies built settlement, suitability supplies comfort, and residence supplies continuity. The channel distinguishes habitation from political authority while retaining their connection.

subchannels.name: Exposed Plain and Dry Land
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler stands in a broad open tract without concealment or water cover.
subchannels.active_motifs: exposed open space `ب ح ر:B005/m01`; dry land and desert opposed to sea `ب ر ر:B005/m01`; wide smooth plain `س و ي:B009/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ب ح ر at 82:3; ب ر ر at 82:13; س و ي at 82:7.
subchannels.synthesis: Exposure supplies visibility, dry land supplies environmental contrast, and the smooth plain supplies traversable form. The place scene is the terrestrial counterpart to broad water.

subchannels.name: Hollow, Forest, and Concealed Habitat
subchannels.scene_or_process: A low place or dense growth hides what enters it.
subchannels.active_motifs: sunken hollow or depression `غ ي ب:B002/m02`; forest or thicket used for concealment `غ ي ب:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: غ ي ب at 82:16.
subchannels.synthesis: Depression conceals by depth and forest conceals by density. Their shared invariant is a habitat that removes occupants from ordinary sight.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Human and animal activity is situated in settlements, open plains, hollows, forests, and named localities.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; sea at 82:3, lordship at 82:6, balance at 82:7, absence at 82:16, and dominion at 82:19 supply spatial anchors.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Place is defined by obedience, comfort, exposure, concealment, and suitability for residence.

parent_channels.name: Circumstance, Otherness, and Capacity

subchannels.name: Affair, Condition, and Dominant Bulk
subchannels.scene_or_process: A matter is identified by its prevailing state or largest component.
subchannels.active_motifs: affair, case, or condition `ء م ر:B001/m01`; customary condition or state `د ي ن:B005/m02`; main bulk or greatest part `ك و ك ب:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Affair supplies the subject under description, condition supplies its state, and bulk identifies what dominates it. The channel organizes circumstance without treating it as a moral or temporal judgment.

subchannels.name: Otherness and Nonidentity
subchannels.scene_or_process: One entity is distinguished from another rather than merely placed later in sequence.
subchannels.active_motifs: another or non-first entity `ء خ ر:B001/m02`; other-than relation `س و ي:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ء خ ر at 82:5; س و ي at 82:7.
subchannels.synthesis: Both motifs mark nonidentity, but one arises from contrast with the first and the other from explicit exclusion. Their relation clarifies the bridge between temporal laterness and logical otherness.

subchannels.name: Breadth, Respite, and Fitness
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person has room, time, or aptitude sufficient to undertake an action.
subchannels.active_motifs: personal scope, distance, or temporal allowance `ن ف س:B015/m01`; fitness or readiness for a role `خ ل ق:B005/m01`; breadth and amplitude `ب ح ر:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ن ف س at 82:5/19; خ ل ق at 82:7; ب ح ر at 82:3.
subchannels.synthesis: Breadth supplies available extent, respite supplies usable time, and fitness supplies agent capacity. Together they define possibility as a relation between actor and circumstance.

subchannels.name: Equivalent Magnitude and Head-Measure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Value or quantity is described by comparison with a salient bodily measure.
subchannels.active_motifs: wealth or favor equivalent to the head `س و ي:B013/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: س و ي at 82:7.
subchannels.synthesis: The head supplies a concrete comparison unit for an equivalent amount of wealth or favor inside an otherwise abstract value field.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An entity is described by its current condition, difference from another, available scope, or fitness for action.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; otherness and sequence at 82:5, formation at 82:7, and the inability of one self to act for another at 82:19 provide anchors.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Abstract condition reaches bulk, breadth, temporal allowance, suitability, head-equivalent value, and the distinction between the same and the other.

parent_channels.name: Relief, Recovery, and Release

subchannels.name: Relief from Distress and Restored Ease
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pressure is relieved and the affected person returns toward ease or health.
subchannels.active_motifs: opening relief from distress `ن ف س:B002/m01`; softness, comfort, and ease `ن ع م:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ن ف س at 82:5/19; ن ع م at 82:13.
subchannels.synthesis: Relief removes pressure and comfort supplies the new condition. The process moves from constriction to restored capacity.

subchannels.name: Ransom and Formal Emancipation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bound person is released through an equivalent payment or a staged legal contract.
subchannels.active_motifs: ransom or substitute value `ع د ل:B003/m02`; owned person transferred out of possession `م ل ك:B002/m02`; installment manumission contract `ك ت ب:B005/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: ع د ل at 82:7; م ل ك at 82:19; ك ت ب at 82:11.
subchannels.synthesis: Ownership supplies the initial constraint, ransom supplies equivalent substitution, and the written contract supplies the legal mechanism of release. The channel is a coherent transition in status.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Constraint is loosened through expanded space, restored health, ransom, or formal emancipation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the self at 82:5 and 82:19, writing at 82:11, and bliss at 82:13 anchor the movement from constraint to release.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Relief appears as breathing room, convalescence, substituted payment, transfer out of ownership, and contracted manumission.

parent_channels.name: S1. Gaming Lots and Their Container
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Marked arrows are gathered in a container and one lot determines a participant's share.
parent_channels.active_motifs: leather container and collected gaming arrows `ر ب ب:B010/m01`; fifth gaming lot `ن ف س:B016/m01`.
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: ر ب ب at 82:6; ن ف س at 82:5/19.
parent_channels.synthesis: The container supplies the gaming equipment, the marked lot supplies the randomizing token, and the result assigns a personal share. The scene is complete but does not share a strong invariant with the surrounding judgment or uncertainty channels.

parent_channels.name: S2. Horn, Comb, and Clarion
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A pointed horn can function as a hard implement, while a hollow horn becomes an instrument sounded by blowing.
parent_channels.active_motifs: sharpened horn or comb `د ر ي:B004/m02`; horn used for the blast `ص و ر:B004/m01`.
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: د ر ي at 82:17/18; ص و ر at 82:8.
parent_channels.synthesis: Material shape links the pointed implement to the blown horn, but their operations remain distinct. The compact object-centered scene is stronger as a standalone than as a forced member of either craft or speech.
